summary: LATAM Airlines Group S.A. filed a Form 6-K on June 8, 2026, reporting routine monthly operating statistics for May 2026. The filing discloses that the group transported 7.2 million passengers (up 5.0% year-over-year), with consolidated capacity (ASK) increasing by 10.8% and traffic (RPK) rising by 9.6%. The consolidated load factor was 82.2%. This is a standard operational update with no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. Therefore, the filing is classified as 'None'."
